entities.title: Unit tests and the branch-coverage gate
entities.summary: All zazzled tests run with `cargo test -p zazzled`; coverage.sh fails unless branch coverage of non-test code reaches a threshold, 95 in CI.
criteria: Every unit test in the crate passes.
Branch coverage of the crate, test code excluded, is at least the given percentage (95 by default).

checks.description: Runs every unit test; CI runs it on macOS and Linux, and the release runs it again on Linux.

checks.command: sh zazzled/coverage.sh 95 (in macos/rust; nightly toolchain with cargo-llvm-cov)
checks.description: Reads the branch percentage from cargo llvm-cov's JSON summary and fails below the threshold. Test modules are marked coverage(off).
CI's coverage job runs coverage.sh with 95.
